sourceRefs.locator: IV.22, MGH SS rer. Merov. 1.1, pp. 154–155. Chilperic uses royal treasure and enters Paris. His brothers dislodge him. The narrative pairs each of the four kings with a predecessor and a sedes.
IV.40–42, especially pp. 34–35. Frankish succession in 613, the desertion of Sigibert’s army, the capture and death of Brunhild, and the account of Chlothar II taking power over the kingdoms.

summary.de: Sohn Chlothars I. Nach einem ersten Versuch, sich Paris zu sichern, erhielt er bei der Teilung Soissons.
summary.en: Son of Chlothar I. After a first attempt to secure Paris he received Soissons in the division.
